headline: Approved hiring Christopher Parmelee as Fire Lieutenant by a 5-0 vote after three interviews.
summary: Members discussed metal identification badges and polo shirts for members. They interviewed three candidates for one Fire Lieutenant position in executive session. They then voted 5-0 to hire Christopher Parmelee.

decision_titles: Hiring Christopher Parmelee as Fire Lieutenant
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Fire Commission Minutes         
         
Special Meeting 
 
6:00 PM, September 2, 2026 
  
 
Memorial Town Hall 
2372 Whitney Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER / ROLL CALL   
 The meeting was called to order by Chairman Commissioner G. Tinney at 6:05 PM. 
 
The roll was taken by the Clerk, and the following members were: 
 
Present: 
Commissioner Gary Tinney, Chair 
Commissioner Samod Rankins 
Commissioner Robert Mordecai 
Commissioner Nancy Jordan 
Commissioner Thomas A. Madera 
 
In addition, Chief Shelly Carter of the Hamden Fire Department, Koger, and Briana J. 
Belton-Robinson, BC Clerk, were present, along with the 3 candidates for the Fire 
Lieutenant Positions, and Battalion Chief Paul Kobbe.  
 
Roll Call Summary: Present, Voting 5, Present, Not Voting 0, Absent 0, Excused 0. 
2. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  A. Monday, August 24th, 2026  
  Commissioner S. Rankins made a motion to approve the minutes of the August 24th, 
2026 meeting. The motion was seconded by Commissioner N. Jordan. 
 
The motion passed. 
 
Vote: All in favor, no nays, no abstentions. The previous meeting minutes were 
adopted unanimously. 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 No public comment was made. 
4. OLD BUSINESS   
 
 
  A. Fire Commission Identification Badges
The Commission received an update regarding the Fire Commission identification 
badges. The design for the metal badges remains pending. Once the design is 
finalized and approved, production is expected to take approximately two to three 
weeks. 
 
The Commission also discussed establishing a procedure regarding the issuance and 
return of metal badges. It was suggested that Commissioners sign for the badges 
upon receipt and return them at the conclusion of their terms so that the badges may 
be reissued to future Commissioners. The Commission will determine the appropriate 
practice and protocol. 
  B. Fire Commission Apparel for Community Representation  
  As of Friday, August 29, 2026, orders were placed for polo shirt badges for each 
Commissioner. The uniform store, which will produce the apparel, received the 
Commissioners' sizes. 
 
The design and placement will be reviewed prior to final production to ensure 
accuracy. 
5. NEW BUSINESS   
 There was no new business. 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
Executive Session for the purpose of conducting interviews for (1) One Fire Lieutenant 
position.  
 
 
  A. One Fire Lieutenant Position, Promotional Fire Lieutenant interviews: 
 
1. Christopher Parmelee 
2. Matthew Kellick 
3. Thomas Paranzino 
  
  A motion was made to enter Executive Session for the purpose of conducting 
interviews for one Fire Lieutenant position. The motion was seconded and passed 
unanimously. 
 
The Commission entered Executive Session at 6:16 PM. 
 
The following candidates were interviewed for the promotional Fire Lieutenant 
position: 
 
 
• Christopher Parmelee 
• Matthew Kellick 
• Thomas Paranzino 
 
A motion was made to exit the Executive Session by Commission S. Rankins. The
motion was seconded by Commission N. Jordan and passed unanimously. 
 
The Commission returned from Executive Session at approximately 7:21 PM. 
7. COMMISSION APPOINTMENT VOTES   
 
 
 A. Appointment Votes for One Fire Lieutenant Positions 
       
  Commissioner S. Rankins made a motion to hire Fire Lieutenant Candidate 
Christopher Parmelee. The motion was seconded by Commissioner T.A. Madera. 
 
Vote by Roll Call: 
Yes 
Commissioner Gary Tinney, Chair 
Commissioner Samod Rankins  
Commissioner Nancy Jordan 
Commissioner Thomas A. Madera 
Commissioner Robert Mordecai 
 
The motion passed unanimously. 
The appointment letter was enclosed with the meeting materials. 
 
Vote Summary: Yes 5, No 0, Abstentions 0, Absent 0 
8. ADJOURNMENT   
 A motion was made to adjourn the meeting by Commissioner S. Rankins. The motion was 
seconded by Commissioner N. Jordan. 
 
The motion was passed unanimously. 
 
The meeting was adjourned at approximately 7:22 PM.
